items.name: The Watch Log: Stolen Stores: rebuilt 81+ page

data.name: The Watch Log: Stolen Stores
data.description:
The third page turned up in a galley ration tin. A list of rations, every one signed for twice, and a note at the bottom in a shakier hand: the stores are flooding.

This weekend's challenges
1. Beat a Quartermaster's Mate once. They crew The Flooded Stores and Short Rations. Reward: Galley Stores and 3 Wreck Salvage.
2. Finish Short Rations 2 times. It's one of the Salvager's dailies in sector 210. Reward: a Chart of the Flooded Stores and 3 Wreck Salvage.
3. Trade with her for a deck chart once. Her Deck Charts trade costs 4 Wreck Salvage, and any chart you pick counts. Reward: a Skyglass Coffer and 3 Wreck Salvage.
4. Win The Flooded Stores 2 times, either ending. Every player gets its chart from Wreck Sighted, and the Salvager's Deck Charts trade has more. Reward: an Archive Chart Case and 3 Wreck Salvage.
5. Beat Isonade once. It waits below the stores, in The Flooded Stores' last fight. Reward: a Sealed Treasury and 3 Wreck Salvage.
All five: a Skyglass Token.

Rules
For level 81 and up; levels 30 to 80 have their own page. Only wins after you take this page count. Do them in any order, and claim each reward from its card in the Logbook. The page closes at the end of Monday (00:00 UTC Tuesday).
data.successDescription: Page complete. The salvager counts the stores twice and comes up one short. "Something down there was eating them."
